consequence.statement: The traefik cmd error log is now emitted at error level, which may affect log filtering or alerting based on log level.

original.statement: The traefik cmd error log message is now emitted at error level.

decision.reason: [ev-b798a55da05a] lists this as a bug fix that changes the traefik cmd error log to error level. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or stops being honoured, so no failure kind is supported. The change is still visible to operators because it changes the level a message is logged at, so a low-severity behavior-change (review) fits better than none. Confidence is low because the evidence does not give the old level or say whether log filtering or alerting is affected.
